Contacts / Whakapānga
Contacts Whakapānga
Key contacts for supporting tamariki, rangatahi and whānau.

Listening to communities

The voices and experiences of tamariki, rangatahi and their whānau are at the centre of our mahi (work). We also gather nationwide data.
Our visits

Nau Mai, Haere Mai

We check that organisations supporting and working with tamariki, rangatahi, and their whānau are meeting their needs, delivering services effectively, and improving outcomes.

We monitor compliance with the Oranga Tamariki Act and the associated regulations, including the National Care Standards. We also look at how the wider system (such as early intervention) is supporting tamariki and rangatahi under the Oversight of the Oranga Tamariki System Act.
